action: Update SharePoint Server Subscription Edition to 16.0.20326.20278 or later and bring Microsoft 365 Apps and Office LTSC 2021/2024 (Windows and Mac) to the current security build after testing.
exec: A fresh SharePoint and Office patch set; no exploitation reported, risk rated High for large and medium organisations.
plain: Microsoft fixed three flaws in SharePoint and OneNote that could let an attacker run their own code on a computer or server. No attacks are known.

key_findings: SharePoint Server Subscription Edition before 16.0.20326.20278 and Office LTSC 2021 and 2024, Microsoft 365 Apps and Office for Mac before the listed builds are affected.
CVE-2026-124222 is improper authorisation and CVE-2026-124223 is deserialisation of untrusted data, both in SharePoint; CVE-2026-126526 is a heap overflow in OneNote.
The most severe could allow remote code execution with the privileges of the logged-on user.
There are no reports of exploitation in the wild.
Risk is High for large and medium government and business entities, Medium for small ones and Low for home users.
recommendations: Apply Microsoft's updates to vulnerable systems promptly after appropriate testing.
Run software as a non-administrative user and apply least privilege.
Segment the network and place internet-facing services in a DMZ.
Enable anti-exploitation features such as DEP and Windows Defender Exploit Guard.

summary: MS-ISAC advisory 2026-134, issued November 16, covers three Microsoft flaws: an improper authorisation bug and a deserialisation bug in SharePoint Server Subscription Edition, and a heap overflow in OneNote affecting Microsoft 365 Apps and Office LTSC 2021 and 2024 on Windows and Mac. The most severe could allow remote code execution with the logged-on user's privileges. No exploitation has been reported.
title: MS-ISAC: Microsoft SharePoint and OneNote flaws could allow remote code execution

validation.note: Reviewed against the original MS-ISAC document.

review.note: CVEs, fixed build, no exploitation, risk ratings match MS-ISAC 2026-134; exec claim outside the monthly cycle not in source, removed
